records.rationale: The diff adds an explicit eviction path in `add-buffer.lua` that removes spans when the ZSET grows beyond 1000: `if span_count > 1000 then redis.call("zpopmin", set_key, span_count - 1000) end`. In parallel, the Python-side guard that previously detected and reported oversize segments was removed (`segment_span_count_exceeded` block in `_load_segment_data` was deleted).
